نأتوي (form VIII)
# نَأْتَوِي (naʔtawī) /naʔ.ta.wiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِئْتَوَى (iʔtawā)
# نَأْتَوِيَ (naʔtawiya) /naʔ.ta.wi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِئْتَوَى (iʔtawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
